## sba-licenses-permits-federal

- **Source:** Apply for licenses and permits: federal, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch-your-business/apply-licenses-permits
- **Supports:** Most small businesses need a mix of federal and state licenses and permits; federally regulated activities need a federal license.
- **Quote:** "Most small businesses need a combination of licenses and permits from both federal and state agencies. Business activities regulated by a federal agency will need a federal license or permit."

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-lease-term

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Section A, Ch. 3: lease term when the borrower leases space, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** Where this paragraph applies, the lender must get a copy of the lease, and for 7(a) loans the lease term including the borrower's renewal options should equal or exceed the loan term.
- **Quote:** "The SBA Lender must obtain a copy of the written lease between the Borrower and the landlord. For 7(a) loans, the lease term, including renewal options exercisable only by the Borrower, should equal or exceed the term of the loan."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-transferable-licenses

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15: transferable licenses as collateral, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** In an SBA change of ownership, the lender must take as collateral all assets conveyed, including transferable licenses such as a liquor license.
- **Quote:** "With the exception of vehicles as described in Para. C.3.d.i., evidence that all assets, including transferable licenses (e.g., liquor license) conveyed as a result of purchase are properly secured as collateral by Lender."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26
